name: Front
description: Front shared inbox and customer communication platform with REST Core API, SDKs and MCP server.
auth_notes: Scoped API tokens created by a company admin; OAuth apps also exist with resource permissions.
gate_detail: Only a Front company admin can create and manage API tokens. Plans are per seat (Starter $25/seat/mo) with a free trial; sources do not describe a free tier or sandbox.
api_scope: Core API for conversations, messages, drafts, contacts, templates and more, with token scopes; Plugin SDK for UI plugins.
mcp_notes: Official Front MCP server with Claude and OpenAI directory connectors, custom connection option and an Admin MCP beta; URL not stated.
blocker_detail: A Front company admin must create API tokens; a paid seat plan or trial is needed for a workspace.

evidence.quote: Front's API settings give you the controls you need to manage active API tokens and what resources they can access.
You must be a Front company admin to manage API tokens.
Front provides developers the following resources for building integrations with our APIs and SDKs.
For comparison, the Core REST API does support templates
The MCP server specifically enables external AI assistants and similar tools to access a predetermined set of Front data and actions.
